## Part II: Phase 1 — Setup Phase (3:00 PM – 4:45 PM)

### 2.1 Executive Chef Setup (Maria, 3:00 PM – 3:45 PM)

**Tasks:**
1. Review walk-in inventory, verify protein quality for tonight's service
2. Check tomorrow's delivery list, note any substitutions needed
3. Review James's and Sophie's prep progress
4. Confirm equipment status with David
5. Review any special requests or dietary restrictions noted for tonight
6. Set expediting station: verify all plating ware clean, sauces labeled

**Completion Criteria:** Kitchen ready for prep crew arrival

### 2.2 Prep Cook Setup (James, 1:00 PM – 1:30 PM)

**Station:** Vegetable Prep / Cold Station

**Tasks:**
1. Sanitize prep surfaces, organize mise en place
2. Pull all vegetables from walk-in for tonight's prep
3. Set up station with cutting boards by item (salad greens, beets, asparagus)
4. Prepare three small containers for amuse-bouche (if applicable)
5. Ensure all cold holding containers are ready

**Completion Criteria:** Station organized, ready for vegetable prep

### 2.3 Prep Cook Setup (Sophie, 2:00 PM – 2:30 PM)

**Station:** Protein Prep / Sauce Station

**Tasks:**
1. Sanitize prep surfaces, organize mise en place
2. Pull proteins from walk-in: salmon portions, chicken breasts, short ribs
3. Set up sauce station: verify all sauce components labeled and dated
4. Prepare mise en place for pan sauce (stock, shallots, cream)
5. Pull remaining ingredients for tonight's sauces

**Completion Criteria:** Station organized, proteins portioned, sauces ready

### 2.4 Line Cook Setup (Elena, 4:00 PM – 4:45 PM)

**Tasks:**

**Completion Criteria:** Grill at temperature, all tools accessible, station ready

### 2.5 Hot Line Setup (David, 2:00 PM – 4:30 PM)

**Station:** Sauté / Hot Line Lead

**Tasks:**

2. Set up station:锅, sauté pans, strainers, etc.

4. Coordinate with Elena on grill setup
5. Prepare all sauté mise en place

**Completion Criteria:** Hot line fully set up, all components ready

### 2.6 Support Setup (Tyler, 4:00 PM – 4:45 PM)

**Responsibilities:**

## Part IV: Phase 3 — Service Phase (5:30 PM – 9:30 PM)

### 4.1 Service Flow Overview

**Service Phases:**

| Phase | Time | Expected Covers | Staffing | Notes |
|-------|------|----------------|----------|-------|
| Early Service | 5:30 – 6:15 | 4-6 | Full team | Typically lighter, allows warm-up |
| First Rush | 6:15 – 7:15 | 8-12 | Full team | Peak early covers |
| Peak Service | 7:15 – 8:15 | 10-14 | Full team + coordination | Highest volume period |
| Wind Down | 8:15 – 9:30 | 4-8 | Reduced attention possible | Late evening service |

### 4.2 Communication Protocols

**Calls:**

| Call | When Used | Response |
|------|-----------|----------|
| "Order in" | New tickets arrive | "Heard" from relevant stations |
| "Fire [item]" | Start cooking item | "Firing" from assigned cook |
| "[Item] up" | Item complete, ready for plating | "Heard" from expo |
| "Heard" | Acknowledgment of any call | Standard acknowledgment |
| "All day [summary]" | Periodic ticket summary | Exposed to all line cooks |
| "Gap" | Empty time between orders | "Gap" acknowledged |
| "Behind" | Station falling behind | "Behind" acknowledged, expedite support |
| "Need [resource]" | Assistance required | "On it" or acknowledgment |
| "All off" | All orders out, no pending | Celebration moment, then reset |

**Escalation Protocol:**

| Issue | Escalate To | Trigger |
|-------|-------------|---------|
| Quality concern | Maria | Any visible quality deviation |
| Timing delay > 3 min | David | Ticket time exceeds 18 minutes |
| Equipment issue | David → Maria | Any equipment malfunction |
| Food safety concern | Maria | Immediate, stop service if needed |
| Staff shortage | David → Maria | Backup not covering adequately |

## Appendix A: Recipe Reference for Critical Items

### A.1 Lemon Caper Sauce

**Ingredients:**
- 2 cups white wine
- 1 cup capers, drained
- 1 tbsp butter
- 2 cups heavy cream
- Salt, white pepper

**Method:**
1. Reduce wine by half
2. Add capers, simmer 2 min
3. Add cream, reduce by third
4. Mount with butter
5. Season to taste
6. Hold at 140°F+

### A.2 Herb Butter

**Ingredients:**
- 1 lb butter, softened
- 2 tbsp fresh herbs (chives, parsley, tarragon)
- Salt

**Method:**
1. Blend herbs into softened butter
2. Roll into medallions
3. Refrigerate until service
4. Place on grilled items for rest
